summary: Startupbootcamp has current public accelerator information for Startupbootcamp Georgia I. Applications for the Market Entry track closed on 2026-05-17, but the program is scheduled to run from 2026-06-29 to a Founder Showcase/Demo Day on 2026-12-18.

proposed_event.name: Startupbootcamp Georgia I Market Entry Program 2026
proposed_event.description: Georgia accelerator with grants, mentorship, perks, and demo day access for startups ready to launch and scale.

dates.date_range_text: Applications closed May 17, 2026; program runs June 29-December 18, 2026.

sources.title: Startupbootcamp Georgia
sources.supports: Official page states Startupbootcamp Georgia offers funding, mentorship, and a global network; lists Market Entry Program as 6 months with about 10 startups and a GEL 150,000 grant; lists application deadline 17 May 2026, program starting date 29 June 2026, and Founder Showcase/Demo Days on 18 December 2026.

sources.title: Startupbootcamp Accelerators
sources.supports: Official accelerators directory lists Georgia I with applications open label, Georgia & beyond location text, 2025 cohort metadata, and describes Startupbootcamp accelerators as industry-focused 3-month accelerators with funding, resources, expertise, investors, mentors, and partners.

notes: The official Georgia page contains some repeated calendar blocks with stale December 2025 labels, but the Market Entry section clearly shows the latest relevant 2026 dates: application deadline 2026-05-17, selection 2026-05-25 to 2026-06-05, program start 2026-06-29, and demo/showcase 2026-12-18.
As of 2026-06-09, applications for this track appear closed, so the event should not be presented as currently accepting applications.
The page does not state a city, venue, virtual/hybrid format, or timezone for Georgia I; those fields are left null or false rather than inferred.
